shared_elements: enclosed or framed area around a figure
justification: Both show human figures, some holding elongated objects, but that is a near-universal correspondence; A presents a single elaborately costumed frontal figure enthroned within an architectural niche surrounded by dense glyph-like panels, while B shows a scattered scene of stick-like figures with weapons and a large horned quadruped in profile with circles/loops. The manner of depiction differs completely: high-relief, ornate, hierarchically framed and detailed in A versus flat, linear, schematic silhouettes freely distributed across the surface in B.
